lines.text: The LORD will sow Israel and Judah with the seed of man and beast, then build and plant them.
In those days people will stop quoting the saying about sour grapes, and each will die for his own iniquity.
The LORD will make a new covenant unlike the one made when He led their fathers out of Babylon.
In the new covenant the LORD puts His law on stone tablets, and forgives iniquities and remembers sins no more.

wrong_details.true: in their minds and on their hearts

lines.text: The city will be rebuilt from the tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate and never again be uprooted.
